verdict.rationale: Gusto documents an API preview endpoint that validates inputs and surfaces submission_blockers before a payment/run is made (gusto-docs-27, gusto-docs-10), and the first-party agent-facing CLI explicitly implements a dry-run preview + agent JSON envelope + a human-approval confirm gate (exit 8 until --confirm) plus a bundled 'payroll-prep' skill that maps inputs to a draft payroll for review (gusto-contest-61-1, gusto-contest-61-5). This directly matches an agent previewing a run and surfacing blockers before approval.  Missing for 10: an explicitly documented full regular-payroll (not just contractor) preview/anomaly endpoint, and richer anomaly-detection beyond the submission_blockers field; the CLI itself also stops short of executing the run, so end-to-end approve-and-submit is not evidenced.
